description: Defines the IAudioManager interface for Android's audio management, including transaction IDs, method signatures, and class declaration.

classes.name: IAudioManager
classes.description: Interface for Android's audio management system, providing methods for tracking and controlling audio players and recorders.

methods.name: trackPlayer
methods.description: Creates and tracks a new audio player with specified parameters.

methods.name: playerAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes for a specific audio player.

methods.name: playerEvent
methods.description: Handles events related to an audio player.

methods.name: trackRecorder
methods.description: Creates and tracks a new audio recorder.

methods.name: recorderEvent
methods.description: Handles events related to an audio recorder.

methods.name: playerSessionId
methods.description: Associates a session ID with an audio player.

methods.name: portEvent
methods.description: Handles port-related events for audio components.
